decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Design and Access Statement, A/P_001, 002, 003, 004, 100, 101, 102, 200, 200, 201, 202, 204, 205 and 206 received 10/12/2010) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The access doorways to the extensions shall have a minimum clear width of 900mm, a level surface or ramp between the pavement and the floor and a door handle of not more than 1m above ground level.
description: Demolition of small flat roofed brick store and the erection of a single storey classroom extension to the front of the northern block and a single storey rear infill extension to the southern block of the school.
